Range sum queries in O(1), running sum hash map lookups, and range increment difference arrays.

LIFO mechanics, parenthesis parsing, and monotonic stacks for Next Greater Element and largest area.
FIFO ordering, BFS queues, and sliding window maximum using monotonic double-ended queues.
Fast and slow pointer cycle detection, pointer reversal, and dummy head nodes.
Decision trees, subset generation, permutations, and pruning dead branches.
Pre-order, in-order, post-order DFS traversals, max depth, diameter, and path sum tracking.
Level-order traversals using queues, zigzag traversal, and tree boundary views.
BST invariants, in-order sorted traversal, BST validation, and lowest common ancestor (LCA).

0/1 Knapsack, Partition Equal Subset Sum, and Unbounded Knapsack combinations.
Longest Common Subsequence (LCS), Edit Distance, and Palindromic Substrings.
Adjacency lists, cycle detection in undirected graphs, and connected components.
Grid flood fill, Number of Islands, Rotting Oranges (multi-source BFS), and Surrounded Regions.
Kahn's algorithm (indegree queue), cycle detection in directed graphs, and Course Schedule.
Single-source shortest path with non-negative edge weights using Priority Queue.
Find with path compression, union by rank, Redundant Connection, and Kruskal's MST.
Prefix tree insertions, searches, auto-complete, and bitwise XOR tries.
Merge Intervals, Non-overlapping intervals, Meeting Rooms, and coordinate event sorting.
